# Runs 6 & 7 — SdH content: Rxx(B), FFT in 1/B (B in [1.5, 10] T), per-tone onsets.
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

H_OVER_E = cst.h / cst.e

def rxx_vs_B(i):
    g = run(i)
    ch = resolve_channels(g.meta)
    cur = current_channel(ch)
    I = g.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    v = [c for c in ch if c.cid == "sr1"][0]
    R = (g.col(v.col) / v.gain) / I
    B = g.col("magnet_field")
    o = np.argsort(B)
    return B[o], R[o], np.median(np.abs(I))

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
for row, (i, n12, tag) in enumerate([(6, +3.2, "electron"), (7, -1.2, "hole")]):
    B, R, Imed = rxx_vs_B(i)
    F_full = H_OVER_E * abs(n12) * 1e16 / 4  # single 4-fold FS carrying all of n
    ax = axs[row, 0]
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("Rxx (Ω)")
    ax.set_title(f"run {i} — {tag}, n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 (I ≈ {Imed*1e9:.2f} nA)")
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(1.5, 10.0), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False)
    sp = spec[0]
    ax2 = axs[row, 1]
    ax2.plot(freqs, sp / sp.max(), lw=0.8)
    ax2.axvline(F_full, color="tab:red", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_full(deg 4) = {F_full:.1f} T")
    ax2.set_xlim(0, 80); ax2.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax2.set_ylabel("FFT mag (norm)"); ax2.legend()
    ax2.set_title(f"run {i} SdH FFT in 1/B, B ∈ [1.5, 10] T")
    pk, _ = find_peaks(sp, height=0.05 * sp.max(), distance=5)
    top = sorted(zip(freqs[pk], sp[pk]), key=lambda t: -t[1])[:6]
    print(f"run {i} FFT peaks (F, rel amp): " + ", ".join(f"({f:.1f} T, {a/sp.max():.2f})" for f, a in top))
    try:
        so = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.3, r_full_scale=50e-6 / Imed)
        print(so.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"run {i} sdh_onset: {e}")
    print()
fig.tight_layout()

**Read (runs 6 & 7, `data/6` `data/7`):**

- **Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_full = 33.1 T):** one dominant *light* fundamental **F ≈ 7.1 T** (onset < 0.3 T, SNR 40+), with its 2×/3×/4× harmonics (14.1 / 22.1 / 29.5 T). 7.1 T is only ~21 % of F_full → **the light Fermi surface carries a minority of the density; a second, heavier band must hold the remaining ~26 T** — invisible or nearly so at T_e ≈ 8 K (LK damping at m* ≈ 0.06 mₑ leaves ~1 % amplitude at 10 T), and spectrally degenerate with 4×7.1 = 28.4 T where the 29.5 T tone sits. The giant Rxx rise above ~7.5 T is the light band entering its lowest Landau levels. Consistent with the **ABAB light/heavy pair (predicted ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T)**; inconsistent with a single-band ABCA read (one 33 T fundamental, absent).
- **Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_full = 12.4 T):** two **non-harmonically-related fundamentals ≈ 4.7 T and 6.6 T**, sum ≈ 11.3 T ≈ F_full → a two-Fermi-surface hole side with near-balanced densities, close to the ABAB near-CNP pair prediction (5.3 / 7.1 T). An ABCA heavy single band (m* ~ 1 mₑ) would be LK-dead here — the *presence* of strong low-onset oscillations is itself evidence against it.

**Take:** both spot checks point at **ABAB (Bernal)** — a two-band Fermiology on both carrier signs with a light+heavy split on the electron side. Not yet a call: a single-density FFT cannot separate "4th harmonic of 7.1 T" from "heavy band at ~26–30 T", and ABCB (Dirac + bilayer-like pair) is not excluded by frequency sums alone. The discriminator is the **Landau fan at D = 0**: each band's LL minima form straight fans in (n, B) with slopes ∝ 1/band-density-fraction — a heavy band appears as its own fan and produces crossings with the light-band fan; harmonics instead track the same fan. → next: `landau-fan`, n ∈ [−1.2, +3.2]×10¹² along D = 0, B 0.5 → 10 T.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n fast × B slow 0.5 → 10 T

> **05:25** · landau-fan: D=0 line, n -1.2..+3.2e12 fast (111 pts, 0.04e12); B slow 0.5-3 T @25 mT + 3-10 T @50 mT (241 rows, ascending from 0); sr1 100 uV; Vsi=0; base T; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~15:55** (≈10h30m)

Plan step 4; operator-requested next move; follows the runs 6/7 read (ana cells 14–17). The spot checks lean ABAB — run 6 (e, n=+3.2e12) shows a light 7.1 T fundamental carrying only ~21 % of F_full = 33.1 T with the balance hidden (heavy band vs 4× harmonic degenerate at ~29 T); run 7 (h, n=−1.2e12) shows a pair 4.7 + 6.6 ≈ F_full = 12.4 T. The fan breaks the degeneracy: LL minima of each band form straight fans in (n, B) — harmonics track the *same* fan, a heavy band makes its *own* fan with ~4× the slope plus crossings with the light fan (ABAB fingerprint); a single 4-fold fan → ABCA; a Dirac-mode fan coexisting with a bilayer fan → ABCB. The D = 0 CNP column doubles as a gap-vs-B read.

**Design.** Fast axis: n = −1.2 → +3.2×10¹² (111 pts, Δn = 0.04×10¹²) co-sweeping (V_tg, V_bg) along D = 0 per the run-5 calibration — ≥ 4.8 pts per 4-fold LL above 2 T. Slow axis: B ascending from the 0 T park, 25 mT to 3 T then 50 mT to 10 T (241 rows) — dense where the heavy-band period B²/26 T crowds. sr1 fixed 100 µV (10 kΩ FS, run-5 gatemap sizing); **coverage trade:** the CNP column may soft-clip at high B if a field gap opens — accepted, a clipped CNP is itself a gap lower-bound, and re-ranging mid-fan would break row-to-row comparability. Hole side stops at −1.2×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit); D ≠ 0 is deliberately excluded — the gap-vs-D leg rides down from 10 T afterwards if needed.

**Price:** in-row 110 × 1.10 s = 121 s (run-5 gatemap actuals: 1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0), turnaround ≈ 7 s + B-ramp 11 s (25 mT) / 22 s (50 mT) → 100 × 139 s + 141 × 150 s ≈ 9.7 h; headline with the session's ~7 % overrun margin ≈ **10 h 30 m**. Ends at **10 T** with gates at 0.

**Checkpoints:** first rows (rail/leak/dead channel — kill inside 10 min); interim fan re-forms at ~1.5 T (~1.2 h), ~3 T (~4 h), ~6 T (~7.5 h) — continue/adjust/abandon; abandon costs the elapsed hours, continuing to 10 T buys the heavy-band window (its LK amplitude only turns on above ~6 T at T_e ≈ 8 K). Leak guard trips at 1 nA on either Keithley.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan`): n fast along D = 0, B slow 0.5 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.2, 3.2, 111)             # 1e12 cm^-2, delta-n = 0.04e12, D = 0
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, 0.0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
print(f"fast axis: n = {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts) along D = 0 -> "
      f"Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}] V, Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}] V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan ascends from 0), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"

# --- slow axis: B ascending, two segments (LL features crowd as B^2/F at low B) ---
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.5, 3.0, 0.025), np.arange(3.0, 10.0001, 0.05))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA (run-5 gatemap choice; CNP column may
# soft-clip at high B if a field-induced gap opens there — accepted, flagged by hera-watch).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"B: {len(B_vec)} rows, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T (25 mT to 3 T, 50 mT above); "
      f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s; fast/slow delay {FAST_DELAY}/{SLOW_DELAY} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan: n fast {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts) along D = 0 "
                  f"(run-5 cal), B slow 0.5->3 T 25 mT + 3->10 T 50 mT ({len(B_vec)} rows), Vsi = 0, sr1 100 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'n fast [-1.2, +3.2]e12 111 pts (0.04e12) along D = 0; B slow 0.5 -> 3 T 25 mT + 3 -> 10 T 50 mT '
              f'({len(B_vec)} rows, ascending from park at 0); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, '
              f'n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; follows runs 6/7 spot checks')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec],
                     [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
# field stays at 10 T (never re-traverse; next leg rides it down)
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates at 0, T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
